summary: Hall Chadwick Acquisition Corp (a blank-check company) filed an 8-K announcing a definitive business combination agreement with REEcycle Holdings, Inc., a rare earth element recycler. The transaction values REEcycle at ~$400M total equity consideration (including up to $50M contingent), paid entirely in stock of the combined company. Prior to close, the SPAC will domesticate from a Cayman exempted company to a Delaware corporation. The deal requires shareholder approval and an effective Form S-4. Up to 8.75M additional shares may be issued post-close. Watch for S-4 effectiveness, shareholder vote, and any redemption risk.
